notes.title: 🐱 Chubby Cats is now LIVE on Steam! Demo available now! 🎮
notes.notes:
🐱 Chubby Cats is now LIVE on Steam! Demo available now! 🎮

🎉 March 27th - Come and try it now!
Chubby Cats is now officially live on Steam! Plus, our free demo is available for download! Experience this unique game that combines island placement strategy and recipe crafting.

Chubby Cats is a relaxing yet challenging game where you need to place islands to gather ingredients, cook delicious meals, and serve them to a group of picky cats. Each cat has its own preferences, and you'll need to think strategically to meet their demands under time pressure.

Game Features:
🏝 Creative Island Placement: Use different shaped islands to produce various ingredients, influencing the quality and type of food!
🍎 Ingredient Crafting: Combine ingredients into more advanced dishes and satisfy those picky cats with your culinary skills!
🐱 Cat Customer Mechanism: Cats have limited patience, and they’ll walk away if you make them wait too long! Can you handle the pressure?
🌊 Map Challenges & Traps: Be mindful of obstacles like reefs and rocks, as wrong island placement can shatter your food dreams!
⭐ Star Rating Challenges: Aim for the highest rating in each level. Only the best chefs can achieve a full 3-star rating!
Demo Content:
📅 Demo available now:

7 levels
6 ingredients
4 recipes
🎮 Full version planned for release in June, featuring more levels, ingredients, and recipes. Stay tuned!

Add to your Wishlist NOW!
Wishlist is crucial for indie games as it helps us get more exposure and notifies you as soon as the full game launches! If you love strategy, creative island placement, and the joy of being controlled by demanding cats (a very normal cat owner experience, right?), come join us for this fun-filled adventure!

Thanks for your support, and let’s get ready for a feast with these hungry cats!
